description.value: Bosa Foods is a Vancouver institution with over 60 years of experience importing and distributing specialty Italian and Mediterranean foods, carrying more than 7,000 SKUs across categories like olive oils, cured meats, cheeses, pastas, olives, and preserved vegetables. The Victoria Drive retail location is one of two Vancouver stores and stocks hard-to-find imported ingredients alongside a full deli. An in-store café serves homemade panini and espresso, offering a satisfying resupply stop for cyclists exploring East Vancouver.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Bosa Foods at 562 Victoria Drive as an active specialty Italian and Mediterranean food retailer and importer with 60+ years of operation; the OSM address and phone match the website exactly. The website mentions an in-store café serving panini and espresso, confirming hot prepared food. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, bike racks, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: The website's /contact/ page lists 604-253-5578 as the general contact number — this is the Kootenay Street location's phone, not the Victoria Drive location's phone (604-216-2659). Cyclists using the contact page may be given the wrong number.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established specialty grocery retailer with a café in East Vancouver; useful for touring cyclists needing quality resupply, and the listing is well-supported by both OSM and website evidence.
